# Bruno Tager — Product Designer

> AI-native UX/UI designer with 16 years of experience. I design products that help people act, not hesitate.

## About

Bruno Tager is a product designer based in Washington, DC, with 16 years of experience spanning strategic communications, operations, and product design. He removes the friction between user intention and action.
